about: Big Green Adventures, which also trades as Big Green Surf School, is an outdoor activity company based at Crantock in north Cornwall. It teaches surfing on the National Trust-owned Crantock Beach and also runs paddleboarding, kayaking, coasteering, kids' beach sessions and surf clubs, plus surf retreats abroad.
offers: Group surf lessons (max 6 per group, ages 8+, all abilities)
Private one-to-one lessons, with extra surfers able to join
Kids' Beach Squad and adult and kids' surf clubs
goodToKnow: Group lessons include 2 hours' tuition on the beach, so allow extra time for check-in and changing
Natural rubber C-Skins wetsuits and Vision softboards are provided
Package lesson times depend on the tide, so contact them for exact timings
Shows the Surfing England accredited surf school logo and the AALA licensing logo
gaps: No season, what-to-bring or cancellation terms on the page.
